ownership: This file only. No production runtime, queue, remote assets, or existing plan is changed.
hypothesis: At matched model and inference cost, explicit supervision of a past observation's marginal benefit improves history use beyond the same generic gate. Generic temporal gates, raw-only inputs and counterfactual utility are not claimed novel by themselves.

launch_readiness.baseline_selection: Resolve from the accepted stage2 audit before this experiment. Copy the exact selected architecture/encoder and fidelity tensors into every teacher/student; no per-arm architecture selection. If no accepted checkpoint exists, stop rather than silently use another seed/checkpoint.
launch_readiness.independence: The 8 dev sources are disjoint from the 32 pilot training sources, but previously tuned. They are a development screen, not independent calibration/test.

data.materialization_status: Selected mixed/time-varying 96-frame profiles are planned, not available as materialized NPZs under this contract.
data.scope: Native-resolution mixed blur/noise/H264 first. No SR or general omni result is implied by this P1 screen.
data.existing_single_task_npz: Existing 22-frame single-task NPZs may test shapes/loaders and later regression checks; they cannot substitute for the time-varying experiment.

controls.near_clean_rule: PCG64 float32 Gaussian noise, rint ties-even, clip to uint8, keyed by source SHA/window/absolute frame. The same frame receives identical noise in every overlapping history; padding repeats it exactly.

data.reference: All profiles/controls in a source/window use the identical immutable original-recording HR center-crop reference, not the output of a restoration model; original recording is a reference proxy, not pristine radiance.
data.metadata_permitted_for: Training sampling/shuffling and evaluation strata only; never gate or blind restoration inputs.
data.engineering_smoke: The planned 1-source then 2-train/2-dev CPU dataset smoke is not the 32/8-source research screen. Do not start 1000-step arms on those few sources and report the planned screen as complete.

causal_input.scale: float32 RGB /255 on the HR grid
causal_input.availability: slot0 valid iff t>=2; slot1 valid iff t>=1. Repeated boundary padding is not an independent historical observation.

mask_aware_restorer.definition: A new isolated copy/wrapper of the selected blind Rphi. The restoration backbone's first convolution takes 11 channels: filled 3xRGB (9) plus two history-weight maps. All remaining backbone and observation-encoder structure/config are exactly inherited.
mask_aware_restorer.filled_history: x'_j = w_j*x_j + (1-w_j)*x_t for j in {0,1}; x'_2=x_t. The observation encoder receives the same filled RGB stack; the backbone head receives filled RGB plus w0,w1.
mask_aware_restorer.explicit_masks: A missing history is filled with current observation AND tagged by w_j=0. This is an explicit absence intervention, not a claim that arbitrary zeros/duplicates are real past observations.
mask_aware_restorer.initialization: Copy the selected head's first 9 input-channel weights and bias. Initialize the 2 added channel kernels to zero. Copy all other fidelity weights exactly. At all-one weights the new head is exactly equivalent to the inherited head at initialization.
mask_aware_restorer.output: Unclamped RGB; preserve existing RGB residual skip from current frame. No confidence head, VAE, H3, flow model, alignment change or recurrent generated state.
mask_aware_restorer.loss: Use the existing fidelity_losses definition: Charbonnier epsilon0.001 + 0.1*edge L1 + 0.5*identity guard relative to the current observed RGB. Freeze these weights for teacher and all arms; no simultaneous guard or encoder ablation.

shared_student_gate.source: Raw observations only; no learned restoration output or prior decoder feature is cached as evidence.
shared_student_gate.inputs_per_history: AvgPool2d(kernel=16,stride=16) of current RGB, available history RGB, and their absolute RGB difference: 9 channels; add lag/2 and external availability: 2 channels. Total 11. Missing-history RGB is filled with current before gate feature construction.
shared_student_gate.sharing: The same weights process the two historical slots by batching B*2; no slot-specific trainable branch.
shared_student_gate.spatial_grid: Require H,W divisible by16; fail otherwise rather than silently pad/resize. H/16 by W/16 grid: crop96 is6x6, full480x832 is30x52. No future frames are pooled.
shared_student_gate.gate: Predict signed normalized utility z_j; g_j=sigmoid(z_j). Bilinear upsample g to H,W with align_corners=False, no antialias. Effective history weight is w_j=a_j*g_j, with a_j external availability.
shared_student_gate.initialization: Shared first convolution seeded once; final convolution weights and bias zero so initial g=0.5 for every available tile in all arms.
shared_student_gate.normal_forward: One gate invocation and one mask-aware Rphi invocation per current frame. No teacher invocation during student training or deployed inference.
shared_student_gate.other_history_invariance: Gate for slot j reads only current and that history slot. Removing slot j leaves all other slots' raw data, gate inputs and gates unchanged.
shared_student_gate.semantics: g is an action weight; sigmoid does not make it a calibrated reliability probability.

architecture.student_initialization: After teacher freeze, all three student restorers copy the exact final teacher tensors. Their gates are bit-identically initialized for a given seed. All restorer and gate parameters are trainable in every arm.
architecture.parameter_matching: Exact named parameter shapes/counts and initial tensors must match across the three students; only utility-label assignment and auxiliary coefficient differ.

teacher.schedule: An immutable teacher sample schedule, separate from the student schedule, sampled only from the same32 training sources with the declared 12+2+2 batch composition.
teacher.weights: Teacher has the mask-aware restorer and no learned gate. It is trained before labels are generated; student weights are not consulted.

mask_distribution.name: local_binary
mask_distribution.definition: Independent Bernoulli(0.5) per slot and16x16 tile, nearest upsample to RGB grid.

mask_distribution.name: local_soft
mask_distribution.definition: Independent Uniform(0.1,0.9) per slot and16x16 tile, bilinear upsample align_corners=False.

teacher.boundary_rule: Multiply every sampled weight by true predecessor availability. Current-frame weight is always1.
teacher.purpose: Teach both the explicit missing-slot representation and the local/soft weights encountered by students, avoiding an untrained mask intervention.
teacher.freeze: eval mode; no gradients or state updates. Hash complete state_dict/model_config/training source manifest/mask schedule/code/software receipt. Regenerating any label after teacher changes creates a new experiment version.
teacher.headroom_check: Before the three arms, use predeclared dev crops to compare teacher all-history versus current-only and inspect local leave-one-out utility distributions under clean/stable/transition cases. If the trained teacher never benefits from history or intervention maps are numerically degenerate, mark no headroom and review; do not label this a failure of the proposed student mechanism.
teacher.no_auto_extension: No automatic extra teacher steps, model swap or selected checkpoint changes to manufacture headroom.

optimizer.lr_schedule: Existing train_rphi.learning_rate: linear warmup then cosine decay to20% floor, step indexed1..1000.
optimizer.precision: Float32 parameters and utility/error computations; one identical deterministic runtime policy for all arms. Any accelerator autocast choice must be predeclared and identical; default disabled.
optimizer.runtime: No asynchronous data-dependent skipping, dynamic history length, per-arm early stop, per-arm checkpoint selection, or extra forward passes.

student_schedule.source_sampling: Cycle deterministically shuffled source IDs within each profile/control stream. Freeze all16000 rows before teacher label inference. Do not let an arm's losses change the sampler.
student_schedule.frame_sampling: Uniform0..95 within each selected source/profile, same rows in every arm. Early padded rows remain in restoration training but nonexistent history slots have no utility target.
student_schedule.crop_sampling: Uniform valid crop origins on a4-pixel lattice,96x96; same crop/context in teacher-label inference and student training, no augmentation after cache creation.
student_schedule.external_mask_semantics: Multiply by true predecessor availability. The exact mask and its seed are frozen per row; all arms see the same masked examples.
student_schedule.sequence_state: First screen has bounded K3 observations and no recurrent state. It tests local causal use, not long-history memory or indefinite streaming stability.

utility_labels.baseline: For each immutable training row, let a be its true availability times external mask. Compute T(x,a) and, for each available j, T(x,a with j=0); all other slots, pixels, masks, crop and model state remain fixed.
utility_labels.removal_granularity: Remove the entire historical slot j. The resulting utility map is local in its scored output, not a per-tile input intervention or Shapley/additive contribution.
utility_labels.pixel_loss: Unclamped float32 RGB mean absolute error over3 channels against the current clean target.
utility_labels.tile_loss: AvgPool2d(kernel16,stride16) of that pixel loss, yielding6x6 on crop96.
utility_labels.definition: u_j = tile_MAE(T_without_j,target) - tile_MAE(T_with_all_available,target); positive means that history reduces error.

normalization.neutral_margin_meaning: 0.05/255, used for sign/harm reporting, not an adaptive training threshold

utility_labels.auxiliary_loss: SmoothL1Loss(beta=1,reduction=none) between gate coarse z_j and normalized u_j; mean over available history slots and tiles. If none available, return differentiable zero. The same valid mask is used in all arms.
utility_labels.dependencies: Loss labels are GT-based training supervision. GT, labels and schedule/severity fields are never forwarded to gate/restorer.
utility_labels.cache: Store raw u, normalized labels, valid mask, sample-row hash, teacher hash, crop/context hash, target/observation hashes, forward count, dtype and backend receipt. Write once and verify before each arm.
utility_labels.compute_budget: At most3 teacher forwards per training row: one all-available baseline and up to2 removals. Upper bound48000 crop96 forwards for16000 rows. Record actual count; boundary/external-missing histories need no removal call.
utility_labels.prohibit_circular_validation: Recomputing teacher labels with the same teacher only verifies cache correctness, not mechanism quality. Quality acceptance requires the final student's own interventions.

arms.label_assignment: shared true cache; compute identical auxiliary graph then multiply by0
fixed derangement of the same cached utility maps

shuffle_control.unit: Whole6x6 utility map per available history slot, not independently shuffled pixels.
shuffle_control.donor_rule: A donor must have a different source_id and source_group_id and lie in the same stratum. No fixed points, same-source windows or padding-invalid targets. Preserve the stratum label multiset and available-slot counts exactly.
shuffle_control.determinism: Freeze a source-disjoint constrained permutation with seed20261112 and hash the donor map before any student run.
shuffle_control.insufficient_stratum: Fail the cache contract if a source-disjoint derangement is impossible. Revise the sampling schedule before any arm; do not silently leave labels unchanged or pool across severity after seeing results.
shuffle_control.no_leakage: Stratum metadata is used to construct the negative control only; it is not an input feature.

exact_matches: initial restorer and gate tensor hashes
16000-row schedule, masks and labels valid supports
one student forward per batch and one backward per update
matched_budget.auxiliary_compute: All arms load identical cache shapes and evaluate SmoothL1, including coefficient0 arm. Wall time is measured rather than asserted bit-identical; task learning signal is the predeclared experimental factor.

teacher_extra_budget.accounting: Report shared teacher training, label generation, mask/label validation, tuning and student costs separately and summed. This is equal student budget, not a claim that the method costs the same end-to-end as a generic gate with no teacher.

matched_budget.controls_budget: K1/K3 and fixed decay/hysteresis are inference-only diagnostics on the same mask-aware restorer/gate checkpoint, not capacity/training-matched competing learned methods. Run all4 policies for every arm on the same3840 frame crops:15360 extra restorer calls per arm, separately recorded. Together with normal plus leave-one-out evaluation, upper bound26880 restorer calls per arm. Report changed history access and actual counts explicitly.
matched_budget.artifact_rule: Same final step1000 for all three arms. Intermediate checkpoints may diagnose numerical failures but must not select different best steps.

student_self_intervention_evaluation.split: Existing8-source dev only; never feed these interventions back as training labels during this experiment.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.geometry: First-screen fixed centered96x96 crop per source;96 frames at stride1. Results are crop-based development diagnostics, not full480p benchmark claims.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.cases: For each dev source: all3 native profiles plus one identity and one near-clean96-frame sequence. Control sequences are counted once per source, not once per profile.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.calls: One normal student forward plus up to2 whole-history removal forwards per frame crop; theoretical upper bound11520 mask-aware restoration calls per arm, lower at sequence boundaries. Equal evaluation schedule across arms.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.intervention: Compute all original gates once. For removal j set its external availability and effective weight to0, fill its RGB from current, keep all other history pixels/gates/weights unchanged, then rerun the same student restorer. No weight updates.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.measured_utility: u_student_j = own tile_MAE(without j) - own tile_MAE(normal prediction); compare gate z and teacher-derived predictions against this quantity, not teacher self-labels.
reporting: per-source sign accuracy excluding neutral |u_student|<=0.05/255, with positive/negative/neutral counts
per-source rank correlation where variance is nonzero; report undefined cases rather than0
accepted harmful fraction among g>=0.5 and supported |u_student|>epsilon, alongside coverage
RGB PSNR/LPIPS, clean/near-clean damage and adjacent-frame error with identical masks/support
student_self_intervention_evaluation.caution: Each student's intervention utility depends on its own model and gate. Use normal-output paired quality as the primary comparison; lower self-harm from ignoring all history cannot pass.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.teacher_only_check: Teacher cache agreement is a correctness check only, reported separately from student utility transfer.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.recovery_delay: For each method, compare per-frame RGB error to its own fixed current-only diagnostic on the same input; afterframe48, report the first run of3 consecutive frames with error no worse than current-only (within1e-6 RGB MAE), censored atframe71. Also report the entire error trajectory; this is a local-history diagnostic, not an absolute recovery-time guarantee.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.temporal_metrics: Use actual adjacent frames; publish flow/motion-support estimator, support counts and cut exclusions. If flow support is unavailable, report simple adjacent RGB-error changes with its limitation and do not claim motion-compensated temporal quality.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.cuts: Natural cuts must be annotated or excluded from the primary continuous-content profiles. A separate synthetic cut case uses source pairs within the same split; both sources remain grouped in aggregation. No GT cut flag/reset is supplied to the model.
student_self_intervention_evaluation.limitations: K3 spans only2 past frames;96-frame rollout can reveal repeated local failures but cannot establish long-memory error accumulation behavior.

fixed_references.current_only: Use the same final mask-aware restorer with w=[0,0], current unchanged. It is a current-only intervention, not a separately trained parameter-matched K1 model.
fixed_references.fixed_k3: Use w=[1,1] subject to boundary availability.
fixed_references.fixed_decay: Use lag2 weight0.5 and lag1 weight0.75, fixed before scoring; no tuned per-task values.
fixed_references.fixed_hysteresis: Use the same gate scores but replace soft use by per-tile binary state: switch on atg>=0.6, switch off atg<=0.4, retain state otherwise; initialize off and reset only at known clip start. No cut/degradation oracle. This is an inference policy diagnostic, not a matched independent trained architecture.
fixed_references.comparison: Evaluate these policies under the same crop/frame/metric support and report actual edit magnitude, history use and runtime. Do not tune thresholds on the final test.

implementation_acceptance: All-one expanded-head initialization reproduces inherited Rphi RGB numerically within the explicitly recorded backend tolerance
Missing history content cannot affect output when its availability is0
Changing one removed history leaves other gate values unchanged
No future frame, target or degradation metadata influences the forward path
Boundary repeats create no independent-history labels
Teacher/label replay and source/crop/hash checks pass
Shuffled donor permutation has no fixed points or same-source donors
Synthetic known beneficial/harmful intervention fixtures verify utility sign
stage_gates.screen_pass: Requires review: real-utility arm improves paired transition output quality over both trainable controls, improves student-based useful/harmful history discrimination, retains stable-segment benefit over current-only and does not damage clean/near-clean. Report all8 source differences; no automatic SOTA/novelty pass from one seed.
screen_reject: Gains disappear against generic or fixed policies
Gate suppresses almost all history and loses stable benefits
Only teacher-label prediction improves, not student effects or restoration
Apparent gain arises only at scene cuts
Teacher/missing-history contract or data hashes fail
stage_gates.repeated_seeds: Only a positive screen proceeds to two additional student initialization/schedule seeds20261113 and20261114, with all three arms rerun per seed. Freeze the same teacher for a gate-seed robustness test; report that teacher-seed uncertainty remains unmeasured. Shared labels must be regenerated for changed schedules and their cost counted.
stage_gates.later_validation: After repeated-seed support, freeze recipe and candidate before evaluating newly approved independent source groups. The current inventory has zero approved calibration/test groups; no relabeling of the8 dev sources.
stage_gates.no_automatic_expansion: No longer schedule, teacher replacement, new alignment module, H3 integration or LoRA is launched by this contract.
